limitations: Separate RGB/drive processing shares the same simulator; no physical sensor independence is established.
A green elongated candidate is not authenticated target identity. Axial yaw cannot distinguish a 180 degree flip.
Orthographic RGB does not measure height or table support. Drive effort is not target contact force.
Compatible auxiliary observations do not prove that the primary support/contact assertions are true.
Freshly timestamped consistent replay/common-mode forgery and motion between camera samples may pass.
Uncertainty bounds and calibration IDs are declared synthetic assumptions, not authenticated or hardware calibrated.
corroboration.policy: Primary incomplete/unknown is retained. Primary complete requires valid aligned RGB and drive windows, compatible pose/motion, and release corroboration; any refusal returns unknown.

development_exposure: Development uses seed2026101904. Final seed2026102007 was not inspected before source/protocol freeze.
oracle: Frozen native _measure and observe across100ticks2ms; no observer features enter physical truth.

primary_contract.absence_semantics: Absent is a positive observation that the named target is absent, not omitted sensor data. Absent/unknown observations require null pose, speed and force fields.
primary_contract.decision_semantics: Invalid, missing, stale, gapped or insufficient evidence returns unknown before physical scoring. Unknown presence in the scoring window returns unknown. A physical predicate fails only when its entire interval violates its threshold. Any definite failure returns incomplete; otherwise any threshold overlap returns unknown; all intervals passing returns complete.
primary_contract.history_semantics: history_start_s is the beginning of the first sample interval. Each t_s ends one 2 ms interval. Validate the full packet; score only the latest 100 samples.
limitations: Self-consistent fabricated sensor observations cannot be detected by this verifier; sensor provenance and integrity need an independent trusted channel.
A pass means the latest 100 samples satisfy the fixed contract at a declared 2 ms cadence; it is not continuous-time, hardware, identity-estimator or force-sensor certification.
The caller must provide a trusted goal and now_s on the same monotonic or simulation clock as the observations; the packet cannot authenticate its own clock.
Uncertainty bounds are asserted by the data source, not validated calibration. Explicit zero bounds represent an exact native-state assumption; they do not establish noiseless physical sensors.
primary_contract.uncertainty_semantics: Mandatory symmetric absolute bounds in declared SI units. position_m bounds XY error norm, yaw_rad bounds wrapped yaw-distance error. Nonnegative metrics have lower bounds clamped at zero; yaw-distance upper is clamped at pi. All selected samples share these asserted bounds.

scope: Synthetic 30g rigid shoe proxy, fixed PiPER and orthographic calibrated color observer. No learned detector, hardware validation, genuine sensor authentication or policy training.
selection: All scheduled cases count; generation mismatches remain. Hard generation failure seals diagnostics and stops scoring.
timing_scope: perf_counter_ns stages for JSON/file reads and PNG decoding, v03 baseline, RGB observation, drive observation, fusion, and their complete processed-window path. No inference cache; repeats read the same local sealed files, so OS file cache may be warm. Excludes rendering/acquisition, the200ms history wait, networking and robot actuation. Native scene/render generation wall time reported separately. Not hard real-time latency.
